known_defects.defect: The worker seam is split across two views instead of one.
known_defects.why: In one view the two anti-parallel routes (worker->runtime and runtime->worker) share a single corridor, so one of the two seam labels is skipped ('labels: 2/3 placed ... 1 skipped', attempts/v1-a2/check.txt) and the lr alternative reports an ambiguous owner (attempts/v1-a3/check.txt).
known_defects.mitigation: v1 carries e1, v2 carries e2, and the coverage map plus this note state both directions of one physical seam.

known_defects.defect: The backend->container label reads 'user proc' instead of 'runs user proc' / 'runs user process'.
known_defects.why: At 14 cells the label is placed beside its own vertical route with its centre 9 cells from that route, while the sibling branch corridor is 7 cells above it, so --check counts an ambiguous owner (attempts/v2-a1, v2-a2 and v2-a3 all report '1 ambiguous owners').
known_defects.mitigation: 9-cell label; the arrowhead still carries the verb and the label names the payload.

known_defects.defect: Groups are not drawn as bordered blocks with a group title, which the candidate skill promises.
known_defects.why: No enclosing border or group name appears in any capture although --check reports 'groups: orchestration(2) compute(2) storage(2)' (evidence/v3/v3-text.txt rows 12-39 contain only node boxes and routes). Group membership is visible only as border hue families in the ANSI capture.
known_defects.mitigation: Reported as a renderer capability gap; nothing was invented to fake a block.

known_defects.defect: Group hue families are not reliably distinct: in v3 the storage group reuses the orchestration group's two border colours.
known_defects.why: Measured in evidence/v3/v3-ansi.ansi: orchestration = modal-runtime (125,160,184) and Task engine (151,184,206); storage = Filesystem+volumes (125,160,184) and Blobnet (151,184,206); compute = Container backend (211,134,155) and Task container (226,156,175).
known_defects.mitigation: Group membership remains readable from the rank layout and the 'groups:' check line; recorded rather than recoloured.

known_defects.defect: v1 is a thin two-node, one-edge view.
known_defects.why: A tb chain cannot place a 13-cell label at all (attempts/v1-a4: 'labels: 0/2 placed'), so v1 uses lr with a single route.
known_defects.mitigation: The view is kept small on purpose: it is the one direction of the worker seam that has no companion relation.
